rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a one-piece garment such as a baby romper or onesie.

example.english: This romper is very convenient because you do not have to take off the whole outfit when changing a diaper.
example.traditional: 呢件連身衣好方便，幫小朋友換片嗰陣唔使除晒成套衫。
